title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg is hiding the baby dragon? Pick your door — I mean egg — and find out! 🐉🔥 Watch every day for a new guessing challenge!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #FunForKids #Kidify #BrainTeaser #EggReveal

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a baby dragon — but which one?
You've got a purple egg, a golden egg, and a speckled blue egg. Pick your favorite!
Okay, let's find out! Three… two… one!
The purple egg cracks open — and out pops… a rubber duck! Quack!
The speckled blue egg opens and it's… a tiny little frog! Ribbit!
That means the golden egg has the dragon! It cracks open and — ROAR! There it is!
Did you pick the golden egg? Nice! Come back tomorrow for Level 2!
